units.source_text: 真乃‘似觉身浮泪海中’也。”

en.t: It was truly as though my body were floating in a sea of tears.

units.source_text: 薰君看了，觉得尽善尽美，心神为之向往。

en.t: Kaoru looked at it, felt it was perfect in every way, and found his heart drawn toward it.

units.source_text: 但闻随从人在外叫喊：“京中车子到了。”

en.t: Just then he heard an attendant outside calling, The carriage from the capital has arrived.

units.source_text: 薰君对值宿人说：“亲王回府之后，我定当再来拜访。”

en.t: Kaoru said to the night attendant, After the prince returns to his residence, I will certainly come to visit again.

units.source_text: 便将雾湿的衣服脱下，全部送给这值宿人，

en.t: He then took off the clothes damp with mist and gave them all to this night attendant,

units.source_text: 换上了京中带来的常礼服，登车回京去了。

en.t: changed into the ordinary formal robe brought from the capital, boarded the carriage, and returned to the capital.
